The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9b9236021eab20eb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: As γ ↑ 2, the laws of (Hγ, νγ) converge to a unique nondegenerate probability law Pcrit in H−1 (S2 , ground) × P(S2 ), with the norm topology in the first factor and the weak topology in the second. Let (H, ν) have this law and set h = H + log ground in local conformal coordinates. Then ν = µcrit h , where on compact sets avoiding 0, 1, ∞, µcrit h ( dz) = lim ε↓0 (︁ 2 log(1/ε) − hε(z) )︁ ε2 e2hε(z) d2 z (1.5) locally weakly in probability. This positive measure extends across the three marks without atoms, has full support, and has total mass one. After forgetting the three marks, sampling three new conditionally independent area points and normalizing them to 0, 1, ∞ recovers Pcrit. If f maps the new coordinate to the old one, the field transforms as hnew = hold ◦ f + 2 log |f′ |. With any one fixed deterministic normalization of the Ding–Gwynne critical local metric, the compatible chart metrics define an intrinsic length metric on the sphere punctured at the three marks. Its completion adds exactly those marks and is a finite continuous metric Dh on S2, inducing the usual topology. The area and completed metric are measurable functions of the same field and obey the corresponding charge-2 coordinate rules.
